name: gorm
description: GORM on gorm.io/driver/postgres and pgx v5.11.0 through database/sql. managed uses DB.Transaction. explicit uses DB.Begin, DB.Commit, and DB.Rollback. A nested DB.Transaction is a savepoint; DisableNestedTransaction is left false. Explicit nested scopes use SavePoint and RollbackTo. The pool is the database/sql pool under GORM, MaxOpenConns equal to pool_max, not pgxpool. postgres.Config.Conn supplies that *sql.DB; GORM's DSN path uses the same pgx stdlib driver. The logger is discarded so it cannot write on the protocol stdout. Category C faults are the pgx QueryTracer under that pool. Category D discards the parsed commit inside driver.Tx, after pgx.Tx.Commit returns and before database/sql returns it to GORM.

modes.description: DB.Transaction. The callback catches the unique violation and returns nil, so GORM calls Commit. A nested DB.Transaction is a savepoint. sql.TxOptions.Isolation is passed to DB.Transaction for TX-05. SkipDefaultTransaction and DisableNestedTransaction keep their defaults.
DB.Begin, DB.Commit, and DB.Rollback. The unique violation is caught and Commit is still called. Nested scopes use SavePoint and RollbackTo. sql.TxOptions.Isolation is passed to DB.Begin for TX-05.

TX-04.independent-inner.reason: GORM has no propagation mode that commits an inner transaction while an outer transaction stays open. A nested DB.Transaction or SavePoint is a SAVEPOINT on the same connection. DisableNestedTransaction false is the default and still uses a savepoint. This adapter does not open a second *sql.DB and call it an independent transaction.

MG-02.held.reason: This adapter does not use GORM's AutoMigrate or a migration history. GORM has no multi-process advisory-lock migration protocol in the transaction API under test. This adapter does not add one.
